scope: Contacts, a calendar, and email attachments, all through Thunderbird.

topics.title: Contacts
details: Contacts is on the main menu. It lists your Thunderbird contacts, such as Google contacts, with the ones saved here.
Up and Down read each name, email, and phone. Press Enter for details.
Control+E writes an email to the contact. You can also say email John from the main menu.
Control+N adds a contact. Delete removes one after a question.

topics.title: Calendar
details: Calendar is on the main menu. It shows your Thunderbird calendars, such as Google Calendar.
It opens on today. Up and Down move through the events. Left and Right change the day.
Control+N adds an event. You can say add appointment tomorrow at 3 PM called doctor.
Say what is on my calendar today from any screen.

topics.title: Email attachments
details: A message says how many files it has. Press L to list them. Enter opens one.
Control+S saves a file to your Downloads folder. You can also say save all attachments.
In an email you are writing, Control+T attaches a file. Control+L lists the files.
In File manager, Control+N sends the files you chose in a new email.
A forward now includes the files from the first email.

topics.title: Thunderbird connection
details: The Voice Companion part in Thunderbird now works with your contacts, calendars, and files.
Thunderbird may ask you once to allow it. Choose Allow.

topics.title: Yahoo
details: A large Yahoo message is now read from its text, instead of being skipped.
Yahoo files can be saved and sent too.
